# Tanmay Hinge

> Machine learning researcher working on applied AI for the sciences. Based in
> Minneapolis, Minnesota. Computer Science faculty at Inver Hills Community
> College. M.S. Computer Science, California State University, Chico (2024).

Tanmay Hinge (full name: Tanmay Sunil Hinge) takes on problems where a model has
to be right for a reason, not just on average, and where the people using it need
to be able to check what it did. His work spans self-supervised models of
scientific signals, retrieval over regulated text, and language systems built for
readers who act on what they read.

Disambiguation: this is the Tanmay Hinge in Minneapolis, Minnesota, who teaches
computer science at Inver Hills Community College and holds an M.S. from
California State University, Chico. He is not affiliated with human-robot
interaction or human-AI interaction research; earlier versions of this site
described different work and are out of date.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tanmayhinge.com/): biography and an index of work and research
- [Learning curves for kernel ridge regression on molecular excitonic couplings](https://tanmayhinge.com/research/excitonic-coupling/): kernel regression on Coulomb-matrix descriptors for excitonic couplings between molecules. The learning curve turned out to have a knee in it, and the knee was the finding: the data pins down the molecules it already contains while saying almost nothing about an unseen one. Includes a Gaussian process variant and a kernel-width analysis showing no interior optimum
- [Benchmarking graph neural network attribution on synthetic tissue graphs](https://tanmayhinge.com/research/tissue-graph-probing/): a synthetic tissue testbed where the cells driving the label are known by construction, built to measure whether graph interpretability methods recover them. Most scored no better than random and GNNExplainer scored below it. Pooled, a marker heuristic that never consults the model appears to match the best learned method, but the two label classes pose structurally different problems and split by class integrated gradients wins. A weight-randomisation control showed two of the tools were describing graph structure rather than the model, and that control's verdict turned out to depend on optimisation budget
- [Probing masked-sequence pretraining on synthetic mixed spectra](https://tanmayhinge.com/research/spectral-disentangling/): does masked-sequence pretraining learn physical structure from 1D mixed spectra, or the noise? A fine-tuning comparison came back close to null while linear probes on the same frozen encoder said the opposite. A harder regime then showed the representation failing long before the task does, and an oracle ablation refuted the obvious explanation for why
- [Benchmarking classifiers for hiring decision support](https://tanmayhinge.com/research/employability-classifiers/): two survey instruments elicited what candidates and hiring managers actually weight when screening, those criteria were encoded as a simulation with a known generative process, and five supervised classifiers were measured on whether they recover it. Both groups rank GPA first and disagree below it; candidates over-weight coding assessments and under-weight recommender scores. Master's capstone at California State University, Chico, completed May 2024
- [Probing a frozen rPPG encoder for identity under input degradation](https://tanmayhinge.com/research/rppg-identity-tradeoff/): a frozen remote-photoplethysmography encoder, the kind sold as a privacy-preserving way to read heart rate from a webcam, was probed for what else its embedding carries as the face was progressively destroyed. It identified 120 subjects perfectly from a face block-averaged to 4x4 pixels, and identity only collapsed once the outline of the skin region was removed as well, which turned out to be leaking the identity the pixels no longer could. On the same embedding the heart-rate signal barely beat guessing the dataset average, and never beat a handcrafted formula from 2013; its bootstrap interval reaches the predict-the-mean floor, so the advantage over guessing is not distinguishable from zero. The pattern replicates on a second independently trained encoder. The study was designed to locate an operating point that keeps the pulse while hiding the person, and records that no such point exists on this ladder
- [Reading](https://tanmayhinge.com/reading/): what he is reading now, what he has finished, and what is queued up next
- [Photowall](https://tanmayhinge.com/photowall/): photographs outside the research — motorcycles, national parks, Halloween costumes, a childhood in Mumbai
- [A shared GPU cloud for student machine learning](https://tanmayhinge.com/research/model-serving/): an OpenStack private cloud built on a college lab server so students who could not buy GPU hardware were allocated instances and reached them remotely through Jupyter over an ngrok tunnel. Joint undergraduate work, published in IRJET volume 9 issue 4 (April 2022)
